subject: Trial momentum — checklist, owners, and deliverables
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@solstice.ai>, Marco Bianchi <marco@solstice.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps from today's discovery — proposed POC success criteria

Hi Elena / Marco,

Thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap + proposed success criteria for the 4-week POC we discussed so we have a single source of truth: 

1) Core success criteria (measured end of week 4):
- Latency: 99th percentile end-to-end inference latency <= 220ms for typical 1k-token user flows.
- Cost: Token cost target below $0.003/token on average when using recommended batching.
- Quality: Top-line pass rate >= 85% on the acceptance prompt set (see attached sample prompts).
- Integration: Embeddings + reranking pipeline running in staging and producing expected score distributions.

2) Evaluation plan / owners:
- Solstice: provide acceptance prompt set and 10 representative production traces by Nov 30 (Marco).
- Redwood: run 2 baseline model configs, deliver results and recommended config by Dec 7 (Dylan / Monica).
- CS/ops: validate network requirements and key management options by Dec 3 (Monica).

3) Timeline (tentative):
- Week 0 (this week): kickoff + infra checklist.
- Week 1: integration + data ingest.
- Week 2: baseline runs + quick quality review.
- Week 3: tuning/quantization candidate runs.
- Week 4: acceptance evaluation and executive review.

Attachments: solstice-poc-success-criteria.pdf (detailed rubric), poctrial-commitment-sheet.xlsx (owners & acceptance rows), network-requirements.txt

Ask: Please confirm owners and whether Nov 30 for the sample traces works. I will lock the kickoff calendar once I hear back and share a short kickoff agenda.

--
Dylan Brooks
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0113
From: Elena Rossi <elena@solstice.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Bianchi <marco@solstice.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:22:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Next steps from today's discovery — proposed POC success criteria

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the clear recap — that aligns well. A few notes from our side: 
- Nov 30 is OK for the sample traces; I will ask Marco's team to prioritize the redacted traces and the acceptance prompt set.
- On quality: we'll add a small subset of adversarial prompts to the acceptance set to ensure safety gating.
- On pricing/cost target: can you confirm whether the $0.003/token target assumes any specific quantization profile?

We'll confirm owners by EOD tomorrow. Kickoff on Dec 1 would work for us if that suits your calendar.

Thanks,
Elena
Head of ML Engineering | Solstice AI
elena@solstice.ai | +39 02 1234 5678
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@solstice.ai>, Marco Bianchi <marco@solstice.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps from today's discovery — proposed POC success criteria

Elena — good call. To answer Ben's implicit question: the cost target assumes 4-bit quantization profile + continuous batching at a 75ms batching window in our Dedicated pool estimate. We'll include a clear delta table in the baseline results.

Proposed kickoff: Tue Dec 1, 10:00am PT / 19:00 CET (30m). Agenda: intros, infra checklist, data drop deadlines, preliminary acceptance metrics, and confirmation of access. I'll send an invite after I get final owner confirmation from you.

Attached: poctrial-commitment-sheet.xlsx (updated with tentative owners), network-requirements.txt

--
Dylan
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@solstice.ai>, Marco Bianchi <marco@solstice.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps from today's discovery — proposed POC success criteria

Hi all,

Two quick operational asks from the CS/ops side before kickoff: 
1) Access: please grant a staging API key that allows token-level logs (redacted PII) for the duration of the POC. If you prefer, we can sign an access addendum.
2) Networking: confirm whether egress to our Dedicated region (us-west-2) is allowed; if not, we'll provide an on-prem connector plan.

I'll coordinate a 15-minute pre-kickoff run for integration owners on Dec 1 at 9:30am PT so we can validate keys and connectivity before the main kickoff.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
